pool.notes: INCOME rows. Branches read institution NAMES by private substring (hasInst/hasInstNamed) and the raw roster (getInstFlags, stamped once — the ⛔ note at :52), so presumptions are declared with the vocabulary reader. Crisis-scoped because "Grain Sales" (local) and "Pilgrim Trade" assert surplus/traffic and are gated on no crisis; every other row declares "any". Entrepot/International Commerce bonus rows live in tradeGoods.deriveIsEntrepot.json.

rows.text: Payments in kind or coin from tenant farmers; the primary revenue at this scale.
rows.notes: Branch tier thorp|hamlet|village. unhomed: tenant farming (no farmland atom; food-source: grain|livestock disjunction).
